pages.title: The Blade's family
text: The [Spiritgear Blade](spiritgear) has a family now: spear, halberd, battle axe, warhammer, dagger, scythe, greatsword and trident. They are made the same way, from Manifested Ingots, a Bone Chime and a haft, and every one has a **bone handle**.

Underneath, each is a Blade. It ranks at the Echo stations, spends Pulse on echo strikes, takes a totem voice, and at Manifested hits bosses harder and heals you from every blow. What changes is the reach, the weight and one move of its own.

pages.title: The numbers
text: - **Spear**: 7 damage, 1.3 swings a second, reach +1.5. A sprinting thrust hits **35%** harder.
- **Halberd**: 10 damage, 0.9 swings a second, reach +1, heavy (−4%). Sweeps, and breaks a raised shield.
- **Battle Axe**: 11 damage, 0.8 swings a second, reach —, heavy (−6%). A heavy cleaving sweep; breaks shields.
- **Warhammer**: 12 damage, 0.7 swings a second, reach —, heaviest (−8%). Blows go through armour: **30%** of the target's armour comes back as extra damage. Breaks shields.

pages.title: The numbers, continued
text: - **Dagger**: 4.5 damage, 2.4 swings a second, reach −0.5, light (+5%). A strike from **behind** lands **1.75×** as hard.
- **Scythe**: 8 damage, 1.0 swings a second, reach +0.5, slightly heavy (−2%). Each blow also reaps **half** your attack into every hostile around the target.
- **Greatsword**: 10 damage, 0.85 swings a second, reach +0.5, heavy (−6%). The widest, strongest sweep.
- **Trident**: 8 damage, 1.1 swings a second, reach +1. Bites **50%** deeper into anything standing in water or rain.
Those are at rank 0. Ranks add the Blade's bonuses on top: **+2**, **+5** and **+10** attack damage. Every figure lives in the `weapons` section of the common config.
Each one trades something. Heavy weapons hit hardest but swing slowly and **slow your walking** while they are in your hand; the dagger is weak but fast and lets you move a little quicker.
Reach keeps you safe but long weapons do less per second; sweeps and the scythe's reap shine against a crowd and waste their weight on a single target.
The Blade is the all-rounder: no reach, no weight, no special move, and nothing it is bad at.
pages.title: No weapon wins everything
Long and short
text: Long weapons really are long: a spear is about twice the length of a sword in your hand, the halberd and greatsword nearly as much, the axe and hammer half again. The dagger is short and quick.
Reach matters as much as damage. A spear or trident keeps a Rift Hound at arm's length; a dagger wants you close and behind.
Any of them can carry an [anointment](anointing).
